title: fraxinus excelsior var. rostrata
intro: Fraxinus excelsior var. rostrata, commonly known as Green Ash, is a deciduous tree native to Europe and Asia. The bark of this tree has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, exhibiting a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Green Ash bark include its ability to support the cardiovascular system and promote wound healing, likely due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Additionally, the bark has been traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, and its bioactive compounds may also contribute to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
